name: repair_json_text
description: Repair broken or incomplete JSON, including output from language models.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The JSON text to repair. May be one value, or several JSON Lines.

arguments.name: json_lines
arguments.desc: If true, treat each non-empty line as its own JSON document.

name: repair_json_file
description: Read a local JSON file and repair it if it is broken or incomplete.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a UTF-8 .json or .jsonl file, up to 5 MB.

arguments.name: json_lines
arguments.desc: If true, treat each non-empty line as its own JSON document.

name: shape_text_to_json
description: Turn pasted text (key: value notes, CSV/TSV or a Markdown table) into typed JSON.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text to turn into JSON: key: value lines, CSV/TSV or a Markdown table.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Input format. "auto" picks for you; "kv" = key: value lines, "csv" = CSV/TSV, "markdown" = a pipe table.

name: shape_file_to_json
description: Read a local text file (key: value notes, .csv, .tsv or a Markdown table) and return typed JSON.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a UTF-8 text file (.txt, .csv, .tsv, .md), up to 5 MB.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: Input format. "auto" picks for you; "kv" = key: value lines, "csv" = CSV/TSV, "markdown" = a pipe table.

name: base64_convert_text
description: Encode pasted text to Base64, or decode Base64 (or a data URI) back to text.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text to encode, or the Base64 (or data URI) to decode.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: What to do. "auto" (default) decodes if the input looks like Base64, otherwise it encodes. Use "encode" or "decode" when you already know the direction.

arguments.name: url_safe
arguments.desc: If true, encode with - and _ instead of + and /. Decoding always accepts both.

arguments.name: data_uri
arguments.desc: If true, encoded results also include a data: URI.

name: base64_convert_file
description: Read a local file and encode its bytes to Base64, or decode a Base64 text file.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a local file, up to 5 MB. For decode, the file must be UTF-8 text of Base64.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: What to do. "auto" (default) decodes if the input looks like Base64, otherwise it encodes. Use "encode" or "decode" when you already know the direction.

arguments.name: url_safe
arguments.desc: If true, encode with - and _ instead of + and /. Decoding always accepts both.

arguments.name: data_uri
arguments.desc: If true, encoded results also include a data: URI. The MIME type is guessed from the file name when we can.

name: hash_text
description: Hash pasted text with SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, and optional SHA-512.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text to hash. It is hashed as UTF-8 bytes.

arguments.name: algorithms
arguments.desc: Hash algorithms to compute. Default: sha256, sha1, md5. SHA-512 is optional. MD5 and SHA-1 are provided because people still need them for checks; they are not safe for new security work.

arguments.name: include_base64
arguments.desc: If true (default), each hash is returned as hex and as Base64. Hex is always included.

name: hash_file
description: Hash a local file's raw bytes with SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5, and optional SHA-512.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a local file, up to 5 MB. The raw file bytes are hashed, not a decoded string.

arguments.name: algorithms
arguments.desc: Hash algorithms to compute. Default: sha256, sha1, md5. SHA-512 is optional. MD5 and SHA-1 are provided because people still need them for checks; they are not safe for new security work.

arguments.name: include_base64
arguments.desc: If true (default), each hash is returned as hex and as Base64. Hex is always included.

name: chunk_markdown
description: Split a Markdown file or Markdown text into chunks by heading, for search, embeddings or RAG.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a local Markdown or text file (UTF-8, up to 10 MB). Leave empty if you pass text.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Markdown text to use instead of a file. Leave empty if you pass path.

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: Biggest chunk size in characters (not tokens). Default 1500.

arguments.name: overlap_chars
arguments.desc: Characters repeated from the end of one part at the start of the next, only when a section is split. Must be at most half of max_chars. Default 0.

arguments.name: prefix_path
arguments.desc: If true, each chunk text starts with its heading path, like "Guide > Install".

arguments.name: start
arguments.desc: First chunk number to return (1 = the first). Use next_start from the last call to get more.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Most chunks to return in one call. Default 100.

name: outline_markdown
description: List every heading in a Markdown file or text, with its level, path, anchor, line number and size.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a local Markdown or text file (UTF-8, up to 10 MB). Leave empty if you pass text.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Markdown text to use instead of a file. Leave empty if you pass path.

name: get_section
description: Return the text of one section of a Markdown file or text, found by heading title or anchor.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to a local Markdown or text file (UTF-8, up to 10 MB). Leave empty if you pass text.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Markdown text to use instead of a file. Leave empty if you pass path.

arguments.name: heading
arguments.desc: Heading title to find, like "Install". Not case sensitive. Leave empty if you pass anchor.

arguments.name: anchor
arguments.desc: Anchor to find, like "install" or "install-1" for the second "Install". Wins over heading.

arguments.name: include_subsections
arguments.desc: If true (default), include the smaller headings under it.

name: save_chunks_jsonl
description: Split a Markdown file into chunks and save them as a JSONL file (one chunk per line).

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Full path to the local Markdown file to split (UTF-8, up to 10 MB).

arguments.name: output_path
arguments.desc: Where to save. Must end in .jsonl. Default: next to the input, as NAME.chunks.jsonl.

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: Biggest chunk size in characters (not tokens). Default 1500.

arguments.name: overlap_chars
arguments.desc: Characters repeated from the end of one part at the start of the next, only when a section is split. Must be at most half of max_chars. Default 0.

arguments.name: prefix_path
arguments.desc: If true, each chunk text starts with its heading path, like "Guide > Install".
